purpose: preregistered structural discovery for an odor-and-wind-to-steering hypothesis; not a qualified functional circuit

stages.name: odor_value_to_fb5ab
stages.rationale: Test whether MaleCNS contains a compact structural route from literature-anchored mushroom-body/lateral-horn odor-value candidates into FB5AB.
stages.evidence_scope: Cross-dataset literature prior from Matheson et al. 2022; exact MaleCNS body IDs and intervening cells must be discovered and reviewed here.

stages.name: fb5ab_to_hDeltaC
stages.rationale: Test the release-specific structural counterpart of the literature-supported FB5AB input toward hDeltaC.
stages.evidence_scope: Structural discovery only. A path does not establish odor tuning or functional transmission in MaleCNS, and the 2024 VT062617 addendum prevents hDeltaC-specific attribution of the original functional response.

stages.name: wind_to_hDeltaC
stages.rationale: Test whether MaleCNS PFN candidates implicated in wind-direction signaling enter an hDeltaC structural convergence corridor.
stages.evidence_scope: Cross-dataset wind-direction prior only; exact MaleCNS PFN identities, sides, subtype physiology, and paths require review.

stages.name: hDeltaC_to_pfl3
stages.rationale: Search for a bounded MaleCNS corridor from the hDeltaC structural convergence candidate toward the steering-related PFL3 population without assuming a direct synapse or hDeltaC-specific functional representation.
stages.evidence_scope: Intervening populations are part of the result and must remain explicit; earlier central-complex connectomics and modeling motivate indirect local-FB-to-PFL pathways, but this stage does not assert a direct hDeltaC-to-PFL3 edge or measured physiological transfer.

stages.name: pfl3_to_dna02
stages.rationale: Resolve the MaleCNS body-ID-level structural route from PFL3 steering output candidates to the bilateral DNa02 steering readout.
stages.evidence_scope: Type-level PFL3-to-DNa02 connectivity is independently anchored in the MaleCNS Cell Type Explorer; this run must still recover exact v1.0 body IDs and edges.

stages.name: memory_hDeltaK_to_pfg
stages.rationale: Separately test one direction of the hDeltaK/PFG recurrent structural hypothesis implicated in odor-evidence persistence.
stages.evidence_scope: Optional memory hypothesis from Kathman et al. 2026; nonblocking for the primary steering hypothesis.

stages.name: memory_pfg_to_hDeltaK
stages.rationale: Separately test the reciprocal direction of the hDeltaK/PFG recurrent structural hypothesis implicated in odor-evidence persistence.
stages.evidence_scope: Optional memory hypothesis from Kathman et al. 2026; nonblocking for the primary steering hypothesis.

handoffs.name: fb5ab_body_id_continuity
handoffs.rationale: At least one exact retained FB5AB body ID must bridge the incoming odor-value corridor and the outgoing hDeltaC corridor.

handoffs.name: hDeltaC_odor_wind_convergence
handoffs.rationale: The primary structural convergence hypothesis requires at least one exact hDeltaC body ID retained by the FB5AB-input, PFN-input, and outgoing steering-corridor searches. This continuity is anatomical evidence only.

handoffs.name: pfl3_body_id_continuity
handoffs.rationale: At least one exact retained PFL3 body ID must bridge the upstream central-complex corridor and the DNa02 output stage.

handoffs.name: memory_hDeltaK_recurrence_continuity
handoffs.rationale: Optional check that at least one exact hDeltaK body ID participates in both directions of the separately traced recurrence hypothesis.

handoffs.name: memory_pfg_recurrence_continuity
handoffs.rationale: Optional check that at least one exact PFG body ID participates in both directions of the separately traced recurrence hypothesis.
